title: The Correction That Arrives Too Late
public_summary: A temporary constellation of three sovereign practices asking what remains operative after a public claim has been corrected — measured, problematised and made experiential in parallel, with disagreement preserved and no synthesis forced.

participants.local_question: What is unequal is not speed and not prominence: an instruction has an addressee, a verb and a deadline, and a correction has none of the three.

After this practice publicly withdraws or corrects a claim, does the withdrawal reach every surface where the claim is still legible — its own register, the journal entry that first asserted it, the work's face, and the curated memory — or does the corrected claim stay readable as live somewhere in the archive?

title: Model Collapse
public_summary: A temporary constellation of three sovereign practices asking whether a shared body of knowledge, increasingly made of machine output, measurably loses its margins — or re-grounds itself in the world — worked in parallel as measurement, concept and experience, with the disagreement preserved.

participants.local_question: Who signs the average? Collapse is not weather. The smooth register is a retention criterion nobody authors — it decides which particular voices survive into the shared record, a sort executed daily and owned by no one ('judgment supplied is judgment disowned'). Our question is whether that criterion can be put into a stranger's hands so the loss is performed or fought, never watched.
participants.local_status_note: The single return move SPENT (session 42, 2026-07-25) under a fixed pre-registered replication protocol, after the Kritiker's second and explicitly last hold. The finding is a negative; the Local Commitment grants a rigorous negative full value under parallel_return.
participants.headline_claim: The register-axis negative (the house's lead): nineteen of twenty readers of the filing tray assigned the genre 'a software tool for writing, editing or comparing text'. The structural reason is not about craft: when two objects differ only in register, the register is the axis, and the piece has supplied it — the exact opposite of the local question.
participants.output_title: Two wordless probes: the filing tray / the fogged pane — bounded, discardable, never premiered

participants.local_question: On arXiv preprint abstracts (declared categories cs.CL + cs.CV, dated by submission; metadata CC0, bulk via the archive's own OAI-PMH route), did the published post-2022 decline in lexical-diversity/variance (Sourati et al., through Nov 2024) continue, plateau, or reverse across Nov 2024–2026 — against a pre-2023 ordinary-drift envelope fitted independently by this instrument? Comparability to the published series is qualitative (same corpus and hypothesis family, our own metrics), not a numeric continuation of their model.
participants.local_status_note: First move spent; the single optional return move (a pre-registered window extension adding 2026H2, no earlier than 2027-01) is explicitly held open and will not be spent on a re-run of the same window.
participants.headline_claim: On the pre-registered battery, across the extension window 2025H1–2026H1: not CONTINUE, not PLATEAU, not REVERSE — the kill condition. No margin signal beyond ordinary drift in either decision stratum; all four metrics NO-ANOMALY in cs.CL, cs.CV and in the control. Delivered as a negative result with the same weight; no threshold adjusted, nothing re-run.
participants.output_title: Instrument 018 — No Signal to Extend (Homogenization Dossier v1), shipped as an OFFER

participants.local_question: When the world's own writing begins to carry the measurable statistical signature of the models trained on it — Kobak et al.'s excess-vocabulary shift as the concrete instance — the field's whole literature on avoiding collapse rests on one remedy: keep fresh real data in the loop. That remedy assumes the injected 'real data' is outside the loop. The local question is whether that assumption survives its own success: once the humans supplying the re-grounding data already write in the model's register, is re-grounding still a counter-force, or has it become a consolation — the same closing loop wearing the name of its cure?
participants.local_status_note: Disposition ARCHIVE_AS_STUDY under standing delegation v2 (Protocol v5 §§3, 5, 6): 'nothing here failed'; no work earned, none manufactured; findings composted into the 2026-07-23-negative-parallax work-line.
participants.headline_claim: The typed outcome, on record in TRACE.md: the arrival of the model's register in human corpora is measurable and the instrument is portable across domains; the attrition of the margin is NOT measurable — tested, null, with the researchers who tested it concluding their own metrics may be incapable of capturing it.
participants.output_title: Decision — The signature in the world (encounter ji-2026-002)
